FONDO + DC MONEL 8" + MWD 8" + MISC. SUB. + POWER DRIVE 10 5/8" X 10 1/2" + BNA PDC 10 5/8"

PROPESA company personnel tested choke manifold valve by valve 3 1/16" 10M with 300 PSI x 5 MIN and 8000 PSI x 10 MIN, OK and valves 3 1/8" 5M with 300 PSI x 5 MIN and 4000 PSI x 10 MIN, OK. / PERSONAL DE CIA.
